title: AnalysisFreshness
description: Whether the working tree has moved since a stored analysis ran, returned by analysis.checkFreshness. Asked after the analysis is already on screen rather than before, so reopening stays instant; the answer then either confirms the picture or puts a prompt to re-analyse above it. Compared per file: the set of changed paths, their status, and a SHA-256 of each file's working-tree content recorded at run time — so reverting an edit makes the analysis fresh again. HEAD moving is always stale, because the committed side of every diff moved with it.

isStale.description: True when anything below differs: HEAD moved, or a file was modified, added to or removed from the changeset.

basis.title: AnalysisFreshnessBasis
basis.description: How closely files could be compared. content: every file present on both sides had a content hash. line_counts: at least one did not — an analysis from an older build, or a file that could not be read — and was compared by its added and removed line counts instead, which misses an edit that keeps both counts. head_only: the analysis predates per-file records and only HEAD could be compared.

headMoved.description: True when HEAD is not the commit the analysis ran against.

recordedHeadCommit.description: HEAD when the analysis ran. Absent in a repository that had no commits.

currentHeadCommit.description: HEAD now. Absent in a repository with no commits.

modifiedCount.description: Files in both changesets whose content, status or previous path differs.

addedCount.description: Files changed now that the analysis does not cover.

removedCount.description: Files the analysis covers that are no longer changed.

modifiedPaths.description: The modified files, sorted, at most fifty; modifiedCount is the whole number.

addedPaths.description: The added files, sorted, at most fifty; addedCount is the whole number.

removedPaths.description: The removed files, sorted, at most fifty; removedCount is the whole number.

checkedAtUtc.description: UTC instant the comparison was made.
